content.comment_body: Hello all. Does anyone know how to change the admin password? The manual mentions: Menu access security [product_name] provides two access levels: administrator and operator, restricting access to certain programming menus. Administrators have full access, while operators have limited menu visibility. The default is administrator, but you can switch to operator. To return to administrator, you need a valid password (default is "[product_name]"). Note: For enhanced menu security, [company_name] recommends using a strong password—at least eight characters, mixing letters, numbers, and special characters, avoiding common words and personal information. Keep it confidential and update it regularly. However, I couldn't locate a procedure for changing the ADMINISTRATOR password—only one for the PROGRAM password.
Go to Access Control: Tools > Transfer > Access Control. Enter and confirm the new password, then click 'Apply'.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unsure how to update the administrator password for [product_name] and points out that the manual only explains changing the program password. Another user quickly directs them to the correct software menu, helping resolve the confusion. The initial uncertainty was caused by lack of clarity between password types in official documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants step-by-step, clearly documented instructions for updating the administrator password, preferably included in the manual and product interface.
